name: comp-412
blurb: Social proof badge showing avatars with trust message.
description: Renders four circular avatars at 20px size inside a bordered pill with text saying 'Trusted by 60K+ developers.' The avatars have ring-1 borders and are tightly packed with negative margins.
use_when: Header or hero sections where a trust badge adds credibility, showing user count and visual social proof together.
avoid_when: When the developer count is not a selling point, or when space is extremely limited.
a11y: Avatar images have alt text. Text is semantic and readable. No interactive elements.
